svg.title: Доброе утро с гантелью — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Dumbbell good morning, side three-quarter view. The athlete holds ONE recognizable compact dumbbell horizontally across the UPPER CHEST close to sternum with both hands at both ends; same dumbbell stays pressed to chest in both frames, never hangs down. Left: tall standing, feet shoulder width flat on floor, knees softly bent. Right: move buttocks back and hinge forward about forty-five degrees from hips with neutral long spine, knees keep same slight bend, feet fixed. Elbows close to torso, dumbbell follows chest. No barbell, kettlebell, squat, or deadlift hanging weight. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
